cases.evidence: piece ended before the genitive/infinitival complement; translation tied 'intentions' to wrong participant
cases.proposed_rule: Avoid high-confidence boundaries that split a noun from an immediately following possessor/genitive or an infinitival complement (e.g. 'NOUN + anderer' or 'NOUN + zu-INF'); rank those cuts lower so the complement survives when possible.

example_pair.input: Neben diesen Fähigkeiten ist es entscheidend, die Absichten anderer zu verstehen.
example_pair.output: Neben diesen Fähigkeiten ist es entscheidend, die Absichten anderer zu verstehen. <SEG:1>

cases.evidence: translation finalized object before the governing infinitive 'aufrechtzuerhalten' arrived; caused wrong verb-object attachment
cases.proposed_rule: Do not give top rank to boundaries that cut between an object/noun phrase and a following clause or clause-final infinitive; prefer boundaries after the infinitive or lower their confidence.

example_pair.input: Das Kräftegleichgewicht war ein System, in dem die europäischen Nationen danach strebten, die nationale Souveränität aller europäischen Staaten aufrechtzuerhalten,
example_pair.output: Das Kräftegleichgewicht war ein System, in dem die europäischen Nationen danach strebten, die nationale Souveränität aller europäischen Staaten aufrechtzuerhalten, <SEG:1>

cases.evidence: boundary left 'mit westlicher Prägung' isolated and system chose literal 'western embossing' instead of 'Western feel/character' when modifier 'und Qualität' followed
cases.proposed_rule: Penalize high-confidence cuts inside coordinated descriptive noun phrases of the form 'mit ADJ NOUN und NOUN' where the first noun is figurative; treat the combined phrase as one unit (lower boundary rank) or mark a candidate as low-confidence.

example_pair.input: Hotels, Essen und Dienstleistungen mit westlicher Prägung und Qualität in Anspruch zu nehmen,
example_pair.output: Hotels, Essen und Dienstleistungen mit westlicher Prägung und Qualität in Anspruch zu nehmen, <SEG:1>

cases.evidence: commas introducing explanatory/appositive clause were given relatively high rank; resulted in premature lexical choice for 'Länder' before disambiguating context
cases.proposed_rule: When a boundary follows a proper name + comma that introduces an explanatory clause ('was','which','that'), lower its confidence unless the comma clearly closes a list; i.e. penalize 'comma + explanatory pronoun' candidates in priority.

example_pair.input: Cinque Terre, was soviel bedeutet wie Fünf Länder, umfasst die fünf kleinen Küstendörfer ...
example_pair.output: Cinque Terre, was soviel bedeutet wie Fünf Länder, <SEG:1> umfasst die fünf kleinen Küstendörfer <SEG:2> ...

cases.evidence: boundaries around predicate phrase and following relative/contrast clause were ranked so a cut occurred before complements, leading some translations to drop key nouns or change modality
cases.proposed_rule: Lower confidence for boundaries that cut immediately after a short predicate ('ist', 'hat') when a relative or completive clause ('die...', 'die ... darstellt', 'doch ...') follows; prefer keeping predicate+complement together.

example_pair.input: Der Guru ist ein grundlegender Aspekt aller indischen Religionen, doch im Sikhismus hat er eine Bedeutung eingenommen, die den Kern des Sikh-Glaubens darstellt.
example_pair.output: Der Guru ist ein grundlegender Aspekt aller indischen Religionen, doch im Sikhismus hat er eine Bedeutung eingenommen, die den Kern des Sikh-Glaubens darstellt. <SEG:1>

cases.evidence: oracle translation disagrees with unambiguous local rendering (timing of accident); human judgement flagged the oracle as suspect
cases.proposed_rule: If the local source phrasing yields an unambiguous, coherent rendering that conflicts with the oracle, mark the item as reference_suspect and preserve the local translation rather than demoting the boundary.

example_pair.input: Während seiner Aufwärmrunde stürzte Lenz von seinem Motorrad und wurde dann von seinem Rennkollegen Xavier Zayat überfahren.
example_pair.output: Während seiner Aufwärmrunde stürzte Lenz von seinem Motorrad und wurde dann von seinem Rennkollegen Xavier Zayat überfahren. <SEG:1>

summary: Two systematic issues dominate: the model over-trusts boundaries adjacent to commas (especially before explanatory/appositive clauses and coordinated modifiers) and it places high-confidence cuts that split nouns from the complements that determine participant, head, or lexical sense. Also, when the oracle contradicts an otherwise unambiguous local rendering, flag it as reference_suspect and preserve the local translation rather than treating the boundary as wrong.

aggregate.dominant_basis: No corpus rate identifies a dominant failure. Read the cases and `judge_distribution` for WHICH mechanism to fix — do not infer a rate from `case_label_counts`, those cases were selected for being the worst.

coverage.of: all sentences scored — a true corpus rate
coverage.meaning: sentences where the tightest budget asked for boundaries the prompt never marked, so pieces are missing outright

premature_among_judged.of: boundaries judged this iteration, selected as the WORST by measured contradiction — NOT a corpus rate, do not compare it against `coverage`

case_label_counts.of: the selected worst cases — NOT a rate
